ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 1:18 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/charcoal pixels. High-intensity pixels are predominantly localized at the distal tips and along the trailing edge margin.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-pixel region covering >95% of the visible surface. High-contrast white geometric clusters are visible at the far left and right distal tips. Minimal light-grey mottling is detected adjacent to the median notch and along the serrated boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 115 degrees; depth is shallow relative to the vertical span of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both lobes; peaks are more pronounced and jagged toward the distal ends, with approximately 12-15 distinct serration points visible per lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edge (where visible) suggests a convex trajectory toward the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly concentrated clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups on the left and right distal tips, indicating dense barnacle colonization. Minor white focal spots are distributed along the trailing edge peaks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacles at both distal tips; irregular indentation/notch on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe near the central V-notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Thin, intermittent high-intensity white border outlining the serrated trailing edge against the background water.
